data.name: Social Space
data.detailed_description:
Social Space is the ultimate sandbox for creating and playing together. Whether you're here to discover something new or bring your own ideas to life, Social Space offers a welcoming environment for everyone!

  • Explore Limitless Spaces: Discover complex, fun, or totally original games made by creators just like you!

  • Create with the Creatool: Unleash your creativity and easily design anything from floppy disks to galaxies

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 170 MB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i7 or Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 980 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
